steps.text: A clack, then the final ball on the table rolls into its hole.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Nice shot.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: How did I only manage to sink my first shot? You somehow got every other ball.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Sorry about that.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I warned you not to play billiards with him, Blitz.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Fuze has been hanging out in Siracusa for months.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: If his Matryoshka didn't accidentally blow up that Famiglia Operation, who knows how long he would have been undercover at that billiards hall?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What've they got there?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Intel.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: That's all?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: ...And a party full of animal ears.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: The one you blew up?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: That was an accident.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Believe me, I did not intend to get involved in famiglia feuding.
Tachanka's laughter echoes from the inner room.
Blitz shrugs, tossing the pocketed balls onto the table. Fuze picks up the triangle frame, gathering the scattered balls.
Following their own 'clacking,' they've found themselves scattered across this unfamiliar land called Terra, each pursuing answers to their own questions.
They've agreed to meet up regularly at this rest stop, to trade stories, compile information, and seek a way home to Earth.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: By the way... where is Iana?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: She's missing yet another one of our meetings?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: No one knows where she's gone, just like last time.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: The point is, we shouldn't expect her today.
Blitz, without an ounce of surprise, shouts into the inner room—

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: You hear that, Tachanka? What did I just tell you?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: So she missed a meeting? What's the big deal?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If she misses the 'spaceship' back to Earth, then we'll have a problem on our hands.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I wonder...?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: No, out of all of us, she has to be the one who'd most like to stay in this land of mystery.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I see light. We're not far now.
What's out there?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It's too tight, I can't move much.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Can you stretch a bit further? Right, through the gap, then slightly to the right.
Wait, we may have a small problem...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: That's enough.
But...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I see now, we've reached a good place.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It's the mouth of a cave.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Beyond it is a forest, with deciduous trees typical of temperate climates.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Clouds, fowlbeasts, a lazy river... Good weather, bright sun, no sign of danger.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Is this where we need to be?
No, probably not...
Oh no...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What is it?
Ms. Meijer, can your Gemini reposition the mechanical arm for me?
If we can straighten it back out... The joint seems to be malfunctioning, and I can't retract it.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Sorry, it's just a projection.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I'm afraid it can't help you.
So...
We're in trouble!
I think we're stuck here!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: ——! What are you doing?
I have to pull the arm through the crack in the rock. We need it for the Triple Aquapit Handstand Twists...
Press this, then this, then pull this all the way down...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: The engine is overheating, wait, stop, don't—
Oh no, Ms. Meijer...
It can't be stopped!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Wh—
The explosion and its shockwave echoes through the forest, startling several fowlbeasts.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Inventor, status report?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Keeping it together. Where I come from, an explosion of that scale is no big deal.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: But there are some issues with the mobility and power modules. I need to figure out how to get it moving again...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I've looked it over. Aside from the broken arm, there's basically no damage.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: It's not every day I see a surface-dweller like you eager to help me.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: By the way, your student there... She seems a little upset.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: She brought back a basket of fruit just now and then left without a word.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Hah, she's probably mad I messed things up.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: When I designed this drilling vehicle, I never imagined it would take such a long way to get to another city to win an inventor's award!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I'd think it'd have some kind of navigation system...

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Navigation? We have no need of such things.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: See where that river goes underground? We just follow that and we'll reach the Durin city we're looking for!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: The maps are in our heads, we just don't know what Durin from which city made this passage so twisty-turny...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Couldn't we just walk right there?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Impossible!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: How am I supposed to attend the award ceremony without my invention?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Are you telling me this stranded drilling vehicle is your entry for the invention award?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I thought it was that 'instant brewing machine.'

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: That's nothing special. The Durin cities are full of those things.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: But with the vehicle as it is, I can't imagine it'll make it past the first round.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: You think it's so ruined?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Don't worry, flaws can highlight the uniqueness of a new invention.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Hah hah! You must know, it's uniqueness that pulls in the votes.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No, the real issue here is that it might not even make it to the event.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Miss, I think you're much more impatient than I.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: The Durin city is right over there, we'll make it sooner or later.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: There might be another way.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I can make it there, as long as I follow this river...

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Yes, just follow the river, pass through four caves, then, when you see the eighth giant mushroom, you climb along the rock wall until...

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Well, long story short, you'll need a Durin guide or you'll definitely end up going a roundabout way!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: More importantly, if you don't bring an exciting new invention to the Durins, they probably won't let you in!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Have patience, let me fix it, and it will surely take you where you want to be!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Where I want to be...?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I hope so.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Alright, leave it to me.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Can you check on the girl? If you brought back some food, that would be even better.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Are we ready to go?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Not yet...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Your master says he wants to fix the drilling vehicle.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Hmph, what a pain! He's so unreliable!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: I already told him that scrap heap won't win him any awards.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: And he actually thinks he can do the Triple Aquapit Handstand Twists with it! Ridiculous! Just thinking about it makes me cringe.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: What are these, Ms. Meijer?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Surveying instruments, survival gear, a few solar panels.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I use them to help me while exploring.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Oh, it's the stuff you use to go playing outside.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: It's important to have fun stuff.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: There's lots of fun stuff at the City's Best Invention competition. I've been looking forward to it for ages!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: But... if I knew it would turn out like this, I wouldn't have gone with him.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Either way, we're here now, so all we can do is wait.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Let's go take a look around that forest.
The river flows gently. Iana lies on the rocks by the shore, staring intently at the water.
Suddenly, ripples appear on the surface. She immediately presses a button on her control panel—
A spring-loaded net on the riverbed shoots up, pouncing the finbeast into the bucket at Iana's feet, all in one smooth motion.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Wow! You caught it!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Inconceivable! How did you do that?!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It's just a remote control, a set of signal transceivers, and a mesh net. It's all spare parts from the drilling vehicle...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I linked them together to do this.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: I see, so this is your new invention!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: It's much more interesting than the drilling vehicle!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: An invention? I wouldn't call it that...
She holds her breath and turns back to the river.
The swaying of the trees, the dissipation of the clouds, and the refracted sunlight create a mosaic on the water's surface.
Suddenly, Iana's pupils show with golden spots.
From another perspective, the shimmering waves no longer disturb her.
Just as a tiny disturbance affects the water's surface, the net springs up again.
A larger, more vivacious finbeast emerges from the river.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Woah! You got another one!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Alright, we're good.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We've got enough drinking water, some finbeasts, fruit, and with the leftover food from before, we should be alright for the next few days... Even if it's a few more after that, we should have plenty.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Can I try?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Take the control panel, hold onto this, and press this button...

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: No, that's not what I mean.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: You keep it.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: We're going to play a game.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Play? What do you mean?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: I'll swim from there. When you see me, hit the button.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: The net will bounce me out of the water with a splash, just like the finbeasts.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I... don't think the fincatching... err, fincatching device can be used like that.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: But it's the most fun water toy I've ever seen!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Let's stay here and play some more!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Here?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Wait, you mean skip visiting the Durin city?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: But... don't you want to attend the ceremony?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Yes, because I want to visit their water park and try out all kinds of new water toys and games from the competition!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: But why bother with that when I'm having so much fun right here! I've got the funnest 'Spring-loaded Aquanet'!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Can we try your new invention again? I've come up with a few more games!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: How about 'Forest River Net Hide-And-Seek'? Come on, close your eyes and count to a hundred!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Here, fruity fin skewers!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Oh... is that 'Durin Engineering' you're reading?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It's a fascinating journal.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It has a dozen pages of Durin research papers and hundreds of pages of Durin invention stories besides.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Say, kid, what does this say here?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Hm, it says 'Knock eight times at the bottom, then turn the input knob to...'

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: That's good. I can make sense of most of the rest, it's just this one part. Are you sure it means 'knock eight times'?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Yeah! Totally sure!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Why do you need to know?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I'm just trying to learn the composition and function of these modules... might come in handy.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: I see, you want to improve the Spring-loaded Aquanet or make some new water toy.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No, I just want to fix the drilling vehicle as soon as possible, so we can move on to that underground city.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: But why do you want to go to the city?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: ...I haven't yet determined the outcome.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I can only be certain once I have seen all the possibilities.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Will you play in the water with us then?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Me...? Probably not.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: But... if you're not going to enjoy the water, what's the point of going to the city?
The point?
Over the course of a journey, speculation is disproven time and again.
She gradually comes to realize a feeling like searching for an important item in an old room.
Scouring the bookshelf, going through drawers, until only a round steel box under the bed remains unopened...
She might have guessed the answer, but she still needs to find the box and open it.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No, there is a meaning to all this.
The next day...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: You're telling me the drilling vehicle still isn't fixed?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: No... that's not the way I'd put it.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: It's more like... the drilling vehicle is unfixable... hic!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: You reek of booze!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: ...All the fruit I picked yesterday is in the instant brewing machine!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Sure is. Made some nice fruity wine... this forest is great, I'd like to stay here.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: I worked on the vehicle late into the night, but I couldn't fix the power modules. Lucky I've got this wine... hic.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: I oughta name it, something like 'Drilling Vehicle No. 2' Vintage, how's that sound?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Personally, I love it. A loving tribute to our fallen 'Drilling Vehicle No. 1'

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Master! Master!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Wine...
Iana sighs as black smoke rises from the drilling vehicle.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What do we do? We'll never make it to the Durin city at this rate.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Sounds good to me!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: We can keep playing 'Forest River Net Hide-And-Seek'!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No... we're done playing.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We're going to that city.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Ms. Meijer? But, Master...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: How many days until the competition?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Three!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: That's a bit tight... we might not make it.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: If we can't make it, there's always next week! And the week after that!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: The City's Best Invention is a weekly competition!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Okay, then we'll shoot for the week after next.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Say, kid, you want to try an even more fun water toy?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I just got a great idea.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Hm? Where am I? I've been asleep for a while, huh...?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: I remember drinking some delicious fruit wine... Ah, yes, my drilling vehicle, I still have to fix my drilling vehicle!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: No, I think I'm actually inside it... and it's roomier now.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: And... it's moving?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Is this really happening...?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Ms. Meijer—

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Miss—
The Durin inventor opens the cabin door, only to be left speechless by the scene before him.
The 'City's Best Invention' nominee, the drilling vehicle he is so proud of, is currently navigating a subterranean river.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Master! You're awake!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Welcome to 'Drilling Vehicle No. 3'!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We should probably call it the Drilling Boat now.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: It seems my hangover hasn't worn off yet. How long was I out...? No, I don't feel drunk, but I am a bit dizzy...

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: So... what exactly is going on here?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Your student and I made a few small modifications.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: It's all thanks to her that I could bring my idea to life.

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: The drill is now a rudder!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: We also installed an upgraded version of the Spring-loaded Aquanet!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We had to discard some damaged parts, sorry about that. But it helped significantly reduce the weight of the Drilling Boat.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Discarded? You mean the Originium power modules...? But how is it moving without power?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: We're traveling with the flow of the water. The river provides some propulsion.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: And just in case that's not enough, we also have this.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: The mechanical arm...? No, it's more like an oar now.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Hah! Who would've thought we'd row our way to the award ceremony!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: This really is... unique!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: What do you think? Should we plow right up to the podium through the dome's waterway?

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: That has the makings of a great story... I need to jot that down and submit it to 'Durin Engineering' later!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Do you feel like it's going faster and faster?

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Yes, it's definitely speeding up!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Oh, looks like we're about to head into a dark, underground river.

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Dark? So...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Open the sealed hatch, kid, we're going to dive!

steps.name: Elderly Durin
steps.text: Dive!

steps.name: Young Durin
steps.text: Dive!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Get ready, hold on tight—

steps.name: Excited Durin
steps.text: Ooooh!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What other secrets do they have? I'll see with my own eyes.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Give me something to look forward to, surprise me again—

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Alright, any guesses on where Iana is exploring this time?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Siestan hot springs.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Mt. Kjerag.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Maybe Rim Billiton, or Minos...?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: In any case... Iana is as curious about this land as any of us.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Her curiosity is just a bit more vigorous than ours.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I only wish she would use some of that energy to find a way back to Earth!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Listen, Blitz.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: If there's a way back to Earth, I guarantee I'll be the first to find it.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Iana?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: You actually came!

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Why did you bring so much stuff...?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: What's this... an Instant Brewing Machine?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hah! Looks like fun! Let me try!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: These files... geological and environmental survey samples from all across Terra.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Columbia, Sargon, Victoria... it's all very detailed.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Some locations are highlighted, they look similar to the cave at Magnethill No.2.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Do you think these places might lead back home?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: No.
Iana pulls out a sheet of paper from the bottom and places it atop the thick stack of data files.
It is her report on the Durin city.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: The conclusion here... eliminated?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: You mean you've ruled out this location as a possible passageway back?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: All my hypothesised locations have failed to yield any results.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I investigated each one, personally, and the Durin city was my last stop.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I've concluded that none of them are linked to the cave at Magnethill No. 2.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: If we're going to find a way back to Earth, it'll be something else.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Kind of expected.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hmph, then let's start searching another route. I'm even more motivated now!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: We could start exploring Originium.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: The land is plagued by Oripathy, but maybe it is hiding the information we need.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Yes, it is possible.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Let's get exploring.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Nothing, just... I thought you would be the last person here looking for a way back to Earth.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Why would you think that?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: I am not just going to sit down and accept this.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: If I've been brought here without any idea as to why... then I need to find a way back to Earth.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Of course, I'll enjoy the sights along the way, those aren't mutually exclusive.
Iana shakes the documents in her hands.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: What's that...?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: City's Best Invention award... and you got a certificate?

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Oh, those excitable Durins gave it to me.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: So you went to see an underground city and happened to win an inventor's award?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Oh my goodness, this prize photo— You all have to see this!
Beneath the azure dome, a peculiar-looking vehicle surges out from a subterranean waterfall.
Rainbows rise from the splash of the water curtain, Durin onlookers cheering with arms held high.
